mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_command(tenant_id,actor_key,operation,request_key,request_hash) VALUES (#{tenant},#{actorKey},#{operation},#{requestKey},#{requestHash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,result_ref FROM tc_command WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_key=#{actorKey} AND operation=#{operation} AND request_key=#{requestKey}
SELECT request_hash,result_ref FROM tc_command WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND actor_key=#{actorKey} AND operation=#{operation} AND request_key=#{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
